header: A garden centre back office, before and after
lead: The same wall, photographed at the end of March and again in mid-May. Nothing was tidied for the second photo.

images.alternative: A whiteboard rota, a rack of clock cards and a bulging folder of notes fill the back-office wall.
images.title: Before — March

images.alternative: The same wall is clear except for one tablet mounted beside the staff door.
images.title: After — May

caption: Fennwood Garden Centres, Wiener Neustadt branch.
note: The whiteboard, clock-card rack and swap-note folder went in one week. Now there is one tablet at the staff entrance, and the plan is on every phone.
